summary: LAGO Evergreen Credit filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 1, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Trustees declared an ordinary cash distribution of $0.89 per share to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, totaling $5,605,702, payable on or around October 15, 2026. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or third-party event is present. The filing is signed by Chairman and CEO Tim Gottfried. The only watch item is payment execution; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
